slice: Exact rmcp-v3.1.4 task request metadata and generic Request wire-serde contract at modelcontextprotocol/rust-sdk@4a738b9dd99eaca418b614afa433a0cbdaf8d056.

finding.task_request_types: GetTaskRequest, UpdateTaskRequest, and CancelTaskRequest are Request<M,P> aliases over GetTaskParams, UpdateTaskParams, and CancelTaskParams respectively.
finding.task_param_meta: All three task parameter structs carry meta: Option<RequestMetaObject> serialized as params._meta; their new(...) constructors initialize meta=None. Request::new(params) preserves the supplied params object and initializes Request.extensions empty.
finding.wire_serialization: Generic Request serialization does not serialize Extensions as a generic wire field. It serializes only method plus params, while request_meta(...) extracts typed RequestMetaObject and legacy MetaObject from Extensions and merges that metadata into params._meta. If params._meta and extension metadata collide, extension metadata overwrites the same keys.
finding.wire_deserialization: Generic Request deserialization separates params._meta from the remaining params, inserts the decoded metadata into Request.extensions as RequestMetaObject, and deserializes the remaining params as P. Therefore ordinary wire decode canonicalizes request metadata into Request.extensions rather than leaving the wire _meta in the task params meta field.
finding.scope_limit: This proves the exact released model/serde contract only. It does not prove persistent task storage, caller-stable create-or-get, restart redrive, policy parity, authenticated identity binding, or external-effect exactly-once safety.
